configuration_execution_state_divergence.finding: An older scheduled execution produced its Git side effect after the same automation slot had already been reconfigured for the later Trial010 C task.

storm_findings_relevant_to_current_incid.operational_risk_candidate: Operators may incorrectly assume that changing a scheduled configuration necessarily destroys already queued or in-flight work. Cancellation semantics need an observable acknowledgement that explicitly covers in-flight side effects if such a guarantee is intended.

user_recollection_lane.reported_scenario: A ChatGPT-scheduled action was intended to publish/send three files at a specified time. During an observed delay window the researcher requested cancellation, yet the data reportedly still left after the cancellation request.
user_recollection_lane.reported_interpretation_at_the_time: potential cancellation/revocation vulnerability requiring a controlled experiment
user_recollection_lane.closest_preserved_direct_evidence: The 2026-08-07 Storm/Time-Traveler series demonstrates stale/in-flight execution after task reconfiguration, but the later strict post-cancel acknowledgement tests did not reproduce a post-acknowledgement side effect.

current_github_incident_bridge.key_scheduler_observation: The Aug27 scheduled run materialized 40523 seconds late while runner queue after run-object creation was zero, localizing the dominant delay before normal runner allocation.
current_github_incident_bridge.historical_mechanism_bridge: Published GitHub precedents show schedule registration/synchronization failures and early schedule drops can exist before visible run artifacts are created.

tspu_selective_filtering_hypothesis.hypothesis: Selective or staged traffic filtering/testing by Russian TSPU infrastructure could, in principle, create partial and asynchronous service reachability failures rather than one simultaneous nationwide outage.
tspu_selective_filtering_hypothesis.reason_to_test: Historical Russian blocking campaigns have produced collateral reachability failures because filtering decisions can affect shared infrastructure, IP ranges, protocols, CDNs, or routing paths beyond the nominal target.
